Used by Button, Badge, DatePicker triggers, SearchInputField results, Select items, Tabs triggers and CodeBlock header controls. Circular and rounded Button variants override it. |
| `border-radius.card` | `dimension` | `var(--border-radius-md)` | `--storm-border-radius-card` | Corner radius for cards and card-like tiles (6px, `border-radius.md`). Slightly tighter than `container` so cards nested inside a container still read as inset. Used by Card and FilePicker. |
| `border-radius.checkbox` | `dimension` | `var(--border-radius-md)` | `--storm-border-radius-checkbox` | Corner radius for the checkbox box (6px, `border-radius.md`). Kept smaller than `control` so the small box still reads as a square rather than a pill. Used by Checkbox. |
| `border-radius.container` | `dimension` | `var(--border-radius-md)` | `--storm-border-radius-container` | Corner radius for large framed regions that group other content (8px, `border-radius.lg`). Used by Container, Accordion, Callout, CodeBlock, FileTree, FilePicker, Table, Stepper and InlineCodeText. |

Matches `button` so inputs and buttons line up when placed side by side. Used by Input, TextArea, Select, Field, RadioGroup, RadioGroupField and Rating. |
| `border-radius.dialog` | `dimension` | `var(--border-radius-xl)` | `--storm-border-radius-dialog` | Corner radius for modal dialogs (12px, `border-radius.xl`). Larger than other surfaces to set modal content apart from the page beneath it. Used by Dialog. |
| `border-radius.drawer` | `dimension` | `var(--border-radius-4xl)` | `--storm-border-radius-drawer` | Corner radius for drawers (32px, `border-radius.4xl`). The large rounding marks a panel that slides over the page from an edge. Used as the default `borderRadius` of Drawer. |
| `border-radius.full` | `dimension` | `100%` | `--storm-border-radius-full` | Full radius (100%) |

| `border-radius.md` | `dimension` | `0.375rem` | `--storm-border-radius-md` | Medium radius (0.375rem) |
